Lina: quick problem report 1 sampled logs + redaction means we can't join traces to the originating PII. ops can't investigate multi-sampled incidents.
Omar: are we talking salted hashes or something new?
Lina: idea: tenant-scoped deterministic field-id (HMAC using tenant KMS key) stored next to redacted field. join key only, irreversible.
Zoe: ok tough Qs: replay, GDPR, attachments. replay needs synthetic values?
Lina: yes1 default replay uses deterministic surrogates generated from field-id + schema. enterprise-unredact stays as a gated breakglass flow.
Rhea: GDPR: how do we delete occurrences if they're HMACed?
Lina: plan: key-version tag on every field-id; on deletion rotate key, scrub within retention window, and mark remaining references as deleted in metadata. legal to author contract language for limits.
Omar: attachments/embeddings: don't HMAC whole blobs. use chunk fingerprints and hashed-span ids for embeddings. store compact fingerprints only.
Zoe: console UX: subtle badge for field-id, action "Preview surrogate" with watermark + audit trail. make surrogate opt-in.
Rhea: routing: add opt-in debug pool (no sampling) behind header X-RI-Debug: debug-route. enforce per-tenant quotas and separate billing tags.
Omar: we need a prototype middleware to compute HMACs and synth surrogates; bench CPU and latency.
DevOpsBot: feature-flag created: "fieldline_playbook_preview" on eng-platform.
Lina: rollout proposal: (1) telemetry-only emit field-ids (2w), (2) console canary with surrogate preview (3w), (3) debug pool + routing + quotas (4w), (4) enterprise unredact via audited breakglass (6w).
Zoe: metrics to monitor: surrogate confusion tickets, collision alerts, debug-pool abuse, unredact requests.
Rhea: runbook: unredact requires ticket + 2 approvers + ephemeral KMS decrypt key + immutable audit log.
Omar: I'll help with middleware PR and perf tests.
Lina: thanks1 I'll open RFC and include cost estimate for debug pool.
DevOpsBot: ticket created: RFC-1756666000-fieldline-playbook (https://r.ticket/1756666000).
